programs.name: NRE Empire — Community Game Night (Kiomet + Openfront)
programs.description: NRE's weekly community game night. First hour: Kiomet coordination and a community match. Second hour: Openfront strategy and a community match. Members can join either or both sessions. Join the NRE Empire Discord to coordinate teams; actual game hosting depends on available members and moderators.
programs.location: NRE Empire Discord / Kiomet and Openfront
